title: FeaturesStrip
description: Why-Helix 3-up feature strip rendered directly under the Hero. Each card highlights a single, concrete differentiator with an icon, headline, and one-line proof line.

items.title: Atomic work-breakdown
items.body: Every prompt is decomposed into small, reviewable units — no more sprawling 2,000-line diffs that no reviewer wants to touch.
items.proof: Plan → execute → ship, one unit at a time.

items.title: Verified before it ships
items.body: Each unit is checked against your repo — types, tests, lint, and protected paths — before a PR is opened.
items.proof: Quality bar enforced per unit, not per agent run.

items.title: Dependency-aware orchestration
items.body: Units are executed in order with explicit dependencies, so refactors land safely on top of foundation work.
items.proof: Parallelize only when it's actually safe to do so.
